phases.judgment: It caught a variant trap: Motorola’s link for the moto g37 power opens an 8GB/128GB model at ₹22,999, far over budget. It priced the 4GB/64GB version, ₹14,999, instead.

phases.title: Look up senior-friendly setup, UPI safety, emergency calling and remote help
phases.judgment: It would not promise Easy Mode on the Galaxy M07. Samsung’s general article does not confirm it for that model and the model manual would not open, so the guide says “only if present on the handset”.
